nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Purifying Foaming Face Wash for Oily Skin

avis.titre: Great on oily skin, does not strip the skin barrier
avis.texte: There's always a lot of hype on this brand. I wanted to try this cleanser since it was on sale. I would definitely say to try it while it's on sale because it's a bit pricey. But honestly, still at full price it's a very reasonable. I wish that their other cleanser was refillable. I think that's the best part. And this is why I got the one with the pump I liked the other Hydro boost brand cleanser, more to effectively take off my makeup. I don't think that this one does that well of a job taken off makeup. I don't feel that like tight drying feeling after I wash my face with this cleanser. So I feel like it's definitely helped not dry out my oily skin. And I actually think that it's kept my skin more hydrated and helped with like aging lines. Luckily, I already have the pump so I'm going to be by the refillable bag very convenient.
I have sensitice, fair, and acne prone skin. This does an amazing job at actuslly cleaning my face and not clogging my pores! Well worth the money!
This product has been changing the way my skin feels. It is so moisturizing as well.

I am 59 years old with combination skin and I use this cleanser over and over. I buy the refill size. It leaves my skin clean, love the foam -can use it on my eyes no dryness or tightness...favorite cleanser
I recently started using this as my skin is in its oily season with the California heat. I absolutely love it. Gets rid of oil and makeup while leaving your skin oil free and hydrated.

avis.titre: Absolutely!  Works GREAT for my teenage grand daughter!
avis.texte: I have purchased numerous products for my grand daughter. She is thrilled with the results of this product.

I've been using this face wash for a little while now, and I can honestly tell a difference. It cleans my skin really well without leaving it feeling dry or tight afterward. My face feels soft, refreshed, and hydrated every time I use it. I also have sensitive skin, and this cleanser hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. A little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts a while. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle, effective facial cleanser.
I have very oily skin and have used many products but none was better than this.

I have been using this for years. I'm in my 30s and have found this to be the best for acne prone skin. It's not too expensive and not too drying. It's great to pair it with the double repair moisturizer or the toleraine soothing moisturizer by La Roche.

this wasn't for me. everyone keeps saying la roche posay is better and since i used to use cera ve sa cleanser but they now have bad chemicals so i had to stop. this was very drying for my skin and so im goin to have to retun it. for the price it wasnt worth keeping.

I've been buying this for months now and I love how it removes my makeup and I don't need any extra steps before I use this. It's one and done. And it makes my skin feel clean and smooth and it lasts a long time.

avis.titre: I WOULD BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN!!
avis.texte: I LOVE HOW THIS FACE WASH LEFT MY FACE MOISTURIZED AND NOT DRY AND FEELING AS IF I HAD A FACELIFT LOL I DEFINITELY RECOMMEND THIS AND FOR THE PRICE IT IS WORTH IT, A LITTLE GOES A LONG WAY

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again
avis.texte: Its the best face wash I've ever used! A little goes a long way! The bottle lasts me a year and I wash my face twice a day! 10/10 recommend!

avis.titre: I'm in my 60's and am red splotchy broken out!! Not normal.
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin and have used Clinique All About Clean Foaming Facial Soap for a number of years now and love it. Recently the price has increased so dramatically I went in search of other options. This came up and super well recommended. One day of use and it's the next morning and my skin is a fright! I am not a teenager who is used to breakouts.
this product hurt my skin and made it worse. I have breakouts all over my face and my face itches like crazy no matter what I do. do not buy.

Omg i love this product will purchase again i love the foam and leave face feeling soft and im just on day two This product was used and recommended by a friends and now my boyfriend purchased which is nice I love it and will add to restock list

avis.titre: It's great for all skin types!
avis.texte: I love this wash! It's such a great way to get your double cleanse in without over drying your skin. Highly recommend for all skin types!

avis.titre: Maybe good for oily skin but not good for combo skin...
avis.texte: So i have combo skin that is rly oily in my t zone and blackheads on my nose, and i thought this cleanser would help. but i guess maybe i shouldn't use it on my cheeks or smthg because after using it am pm for three days my skin was red and really painful. I think it was really dry so I applied a heavy moisturizer but my skin was BURNING! Maybe I should only use it on my t zone but to be honest I didn't really see any results. And it said safe for sensitive skin, but I think it ruined my skin barrier? I don't really write any reviews but i just wanted to say if you have sensitive or combo skin or just dry skin don't try this product. but i rated a 3/5 because i feel like oily skinned people might thrive with this cleanser and the packaging is nice, but just not for me

Honetly i love thos product ive used it twice and it feels so good on my skin, it does not burn at all, a little goes a long way so its worth the price and bottle i just cant explain but you should try it

Second time repurchasing this! I use it as my second cleanser after using a makeup melting balm. I have combo 40-year-old skin and this keeps it clean and balanced. The bottle lasts way longer than I expected, too. I ran out of this before my order arrived and after using another cleanser, it solidified why I like this one so much! I dont get dry skin flakes and my skin feels moisturized not tight after using this one. I will be better abour repurchasing before I run out because I dont like missing this from my skincare!
My absolute favorite face wash! I have one in my shower and sink. Will purchase again!

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I really love the way it feels and makes my skin look . It's definitely going to be a repurchase for me - I have sensitive skin but this has been perfect for me !
This product smells rancid. There isn't an expiration date on the product, but it smells like it has expired a long time ago. I use other products from this brand and they all smell fine.
gentle on skin,cleanses effectively without drying,perfect for sensitive skin

I've tried other foam cleansers and I always go back to this one. I'm on my third bottle and honestly, I really enjoy most of La Roche-Posay products, they leave my skin feeling so clean. This foam cleanser can leave your skin feeling a bit dry but I always go in with a hydrating toner after cleansing and love how my skin looks and feels after.

Within 2 days of using it my skin started flaking so bad it started falling off. It felt like my face was cracking evertime i made any expression no matter how many THICK layers of moisturizers i used. I would wake up with my pillow LITTERED with flakes of my skin. After one day of exfoliation and not using the cleaser jt went straight back to normal.
La Roche Posay just wins on all levels--my husband has oily skin--leaves his face normal and clean--doesn't strip

I've tried everything and I mean everything and this is my tried and true! I have oily skin and this is the only face wash that really cleans all the surface oils and makeup without stripping my skin.
I love this face wash! It is the best. It cleared up my acne.It leaves my skin hydrated and feeling smooth. I strongly recommend this to anyone!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: There is nothing like a good facial cleanser. I like the way it foams up on my face, and deep, clean my face and pores. I also feel that this product is affordable and it lasts a long time. I highly recommend this product, I will Continue to purchase this facial cleanser.
No Complaints, I have sensitive skin as well . Highly recommended

I have used this product for over 4 years and i am obsessed. I used this before i got pregnant and while i was pregnant and after. If anyone has been pregnant yk that you could break out and this product definitely helped keep my acne in control
Worthy purchase. Works perfectly on my extremely sensitive skin thats prone to eczema its really gentle been using it for 3yrs now
I would buy the item again but not from Ultra!!! Customer service is trash!!!!

The past few months I've randomly started struggling significantly with deep, painful hormonal acne on the sides of my cheeks and on my chin. Nothing was working and I was feeling ugly and defeated. I seen a few videos from ladies recommending this face wash. I got an ulta gift card and decided to finally try it out. I got it in the mail 4 days ago, and have used it morning and night since with surface hydrocolloid bandages over the acne nightly as well. My skin is FINALLY starting to clear up (not like before where one finally went away, and two more took its place 💀). My skin is soft, and it's seemed to take some of the texture away as well. I love that it doesn't leave my face feeling excessively dry or "stripped" before moisturizing. I always liked my previous face wash, but I think this has me influenced to make the switch permanently!

I have combination skin with it being oily in the T zone and the rest of my face is normal, this face wash helped balance my skin without making it feel tight/dry and a little bit goes a long way and it foams nicely. I would purchase again!

avis.titre: I love it. I would buy it again and again.
avis.texte: This is my favorite face wash, and I have been using it for a long time.

avis.titre: My new favorite facial cleaner BY FAR!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. The bottom picture is from 2 days ago, bad inflamed breakouts after using this cleanser for two days my acne has cleared up and the redness has gone down significantly. Buy this omg not sponsored at all but this seriously saved my life.
I was looking for a non exfoliating face wash and this fit the bill. It is silky and has a great foam. My face feels so soft.

I placed an order for Christmas, in addition I orderered Vichy face wash ( online only and)in error was sent the product I'm reviewing. May I add , I reordered my original item which was received.

i have used so many different face washes back to back but this??? SO GOOD!! my face has never felt this clean, i feel like i have been born again. after one use, my acne stopped being so intense def will update after a month
So nice and lightweight; when I say my skin is sensitive I have gone to the point of only using bar soap. This saved me and my skin.

I have rinsed my face for 10 minutes, without a washcloth, with a washcloth, pat dry. apply my toner and my face refoams. this is gross. I usually love their products but, ew. a day later, because i gave up, I thought I'd washed it off, and I've still got this on my skin. I want to scream. and it feels so gross.
Such a gentle cleanser. Love that it's light but foams up and my skin feels so clean every time I use it

I was surprised that with this being a foaming cleanser, it did not dry my skin or make it feel tight after washing. Did not cause breakouts and it rinses clean. Definitely recommend!

Im not sure if the company reformulated because ive used this in the past and never had a problem. Could work for you tho!
Ohhhhhhh words can't describe how amazing this makes my face feel!!!!
This helped me out after my skin had a reaction to a face wash from a different brand. Now it's the only one I use and trust on my skin. Highly reccommed for sensitive and oily skin :)

avis.texte: I saw results of using this product within 2 weeks! So worth it. I have oily skin and my pores use to show but this product has helped with all of that even the hormonal acne.
Gentle yet effective.It cleanses thoroughly to remove excess oil and makeup without stripping the skin. Love to refill.

This product sounded like it was the one for me. Wrong. I felt like I was washing my face with tap water. No foam whatsoever. I even attempted to use extra to see if it made a difference. Negative. I felt like it didn't clean my face at all. Most toners do better.

avis.titre: No I would not purchase again

I have re-purchased this face wash again. It helps control my break outs and leaves my skin feeling soft instead of dry. I really like how it foams up when adding water. A little goes a long ways!

avis.titre: A must have for oily-acne skin
avis.texte: I've been using this exact cleanser for years and in the midst I've tried cleansers that were $40-70 and this is way more effective and not as pricey. I love this cleanser!

Glad I only bought the trial size of this. Leaves a film on your face (and I was using it in the shower, so it wasn't for want of a good rinse!). I was planning to just use the rest up and switch to a different cleanser, but the residue irritated my eyes (maybe it got on my lashes?). Once I figured out that this was what was causing my eye discomfort, I washed my face with a different cleanser and threw it in the trash. Do not recommend.
I've purchased this product more than 10 times. It's part of my skincare routine. I love this brand. Highly recommended.
I like the foaming solution of this product.Also i like the way my skin feels afterwards,not too tight or drying.
Feels creamy and lathers nice and my face feels clean and not dry and tight! Only need like half a pump too!
I love this face wash. My skin feels amazing. I use it about every other day, but I could be using it daily. It feels wonderful on my sensitive skin. Will definitely be buying again when I run out!

I have angry whiteheads and clogged pores all over my face- I have never experienced anything like this. I have combination skin so I thought this would work great but it has destroyed my skin. Still recovering from the damage it caused. Highly recommend doing a patch test if you are interested.

Me and my mom LOVES THIS cause i want to try what is the hype of thos product amd i love me and i wanted to do it on my mom gaves amd she love it also so highly recommended!!!

This is the only face wash I use ! It's cleans my face so well with out stripping or leaving my skin feeling dry . It's hydrating and cleansing at the same time . I have no idea how they did it but it works ! I highly recommend this face wash especially if you have oily skin like me

I have been very fortunate to have "outgrown" my hormonal acne. Whether that is from the multitude of birth control's I have been on, or just simply growing in age, I am fortunate nonetheless. With that being said, in the last few months I have been noticing increased breakouts in my cheek area, which was surprising to me as I have been one of those people that maybe gets a pimple around their cycle and just simply rinses their face with water while in the shower. I have always dealt with oily skin so I decided to try out this face wash as I didn't want anything medicated or too strong, but enough to wash the sweat and oiliness at the end of each day and hopefully mitigate my breakouts. After about a month of use, I have noticed a slight reduction in my breakouts, but nothing major. I will say this cleanser is definitely not for "problem" skin or severe acne, but enough for a basic cleanser. It does however leave my skin feeling a bit stripped and dry so following up with a moisturizer is definitely a must. I personally use Bubble. Overall, I'm not sure if I would buy this again but it's a decent price for the size and works well enough.
Ive been using this product for years it helped me out a lot with previous breakouts and dark spots

One of the best face washes Ive ever purchased. I my skin has never been super proned to acne but I would occasionally break out. After using this product I have not broken out SINCE (even during menstrual) and its been over two months since Ive been using it. For the price point there is a ton of product and lasts you months so youre really getting your moneys worth. I pair it with the facial moisturizer and let me tell you, the discourlation that Ive had for years is beginning to fade and my skin is BRIGHT!!! Highly recommend this brand/product.

I ordered about 17ounces of products 2 bottles and a less than 1 once free gift and they sent it in a 24x13x13 box. For product that would have fit in a 10x4x4 box or smaller lol. All was loose bouncing around in this giant cardboard jungle gym. No bubble wrap no peanuts no crumpled paper I'm surprised the pump didn't snap off from the top of the bottle. And what a waste on your companies shipping costs for a box that was the size of a 25 gal. Storage container. Thats the size of one of those black with yellow lid boxes you probably have in your garage or basement. Lucky nothing was broken. But do better. Now I have a giant box I have to tear up to fit the in my tiny CA recycling can. Yes, I would recommend because prices are good and it is a well known company.

I bought the skin care kit.and I was supposed to get a back to school gift.thats why I got it..they said they didnt have it.even thou they still had the sign up for gift.did offer anything else.thats pretty messed up.

I started with the original full-size bottle with pump but used this refill pouch once the bottle was completely empty; no complaints about the refill design. l have combination skin, and I really like this fragrance-free, clean-rinsing, foaming, and non-drying cleanser. I don't wear foundation, but I do wear sunscreen, loose powder, and tubing mascara. This face wash works well for me if I start with a wet face, lather the product in my hands, and then apply it. My skin is sensitive, so I just use my fingers and to loosen and massage the sunscreen and other products off, with just a bit of attention on the lash line for the mascara. Everything rinses cleanly away, and the product seems less harsh than other foaming cleansers I've tried.
Love this product, definitely a must have for oily sensitive skin

I have been using this product for years! I double cleanse with it and it takes off my makeup well and doesnt overly strip my face. I also like how I can use this cleanser both in the summer and winter as I can be prone to oily skin in the summer and dry skin in the winter. I also love how one bottle seems to last me a long time! Another pro is that it seems to help with my hormonal acne as well :) A huge con however is that it is true that the spring in the pump does rust. Ive only recently noticed this but it is gross nonetheless. I still love this cleanser I just buy the refils and reuse a different bottle from another cleanser I had.

Gets rid of the oily skin feeling that I deal with a lot of the day but does not replace it with a dried-out, stretched feeling. I like this a lot and have had zero pimples or zits since starting to use it. I started using this in May and it's now the end of June. I'm very impressed. I first tried this by using a sample I got at a yearly derm doc appointment.

I have hyper sensitive skin ( think newborn baby but worse ) i have wanted to try this brand for years but was extremely lery of it . I normally use korean brands , but it seemed like my skin was telling me to use something els as i had breakouts galore. Decided to give this a try and so glad i did , after 4 days of use i was surprised as my breakouts are almost completely gone . This has not broken me out or made my face red . Will definitely be buying more

This has been the only cleanser that actually leaves a clean feeling. I have VERY oily face that gets worse throughout the day. I started using this and my face oil has been way more manageable with the blotting sheets. Highly recommend
been using this for over a year and my skin has never felt better

I have really problematic skin post children. I really wanted they hype to be true about their products but unfortunately, they weren't. Maybe it's just my experience but my acne is the same, but my skin is way drier (even with using their moisturizers as well). My eyelids are also constantly dried out and I have to end up using Aquaphor to help them without them feeling like they're burning from moisturizer.

avis.titre: Gave me puffy, dry, sensitive eyelids
avis.texte: I was using this facial wash for a week when my eyelids (especially the left one) started getting puffy. I thought it was due to seasonal allergies, even though I had very few other seasonal allergy symptoms. My eyes were puffy, and the lids were dry, scaly, and sensitive. I even went to my optometrist, and she noted that the lid looked like an eczema flare (something I'd never had before on my lids). After a month of irritation, I realized this facial wash the probable culprit. Haven't used it for a week, and my lids are about 85% back to normal (still healing from the dryness and sensitivity). I hate that the return window has passed, but I would never recommend this product.
Doesnt remove mascara. Had to wash my face again wirh anither face wash to remove it. Recommend Derma E Hydrating Facial Cleanser instead. Moosture plus no mascara residue

Have been using for over 3 weeks now, twice a day & I truly do feel a difference. I've got oily, acne prone skin & this has helped clear me up. Can't wait for long term results. Feels moisturizing afterwards too.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: My face feels clean and refreshed every time I wash with this product. It's not drying and my skin still feels hydrated without the feeling of having product I can't wash off my face.

Makes my skin feel cleansed and soft, without irritating or drying it out, and no bad cleanser scent either. A 13.5oz bottle is still lasting me more than a year now, and I use it every day! Knocked 1 star off because it doesn't foam like it says.
This face wash cleanses my face without over drying it. It is kind to my sensitive skin. I love this brand.

avis.titre: Great product, until pump starts to grow mold.
avis.texte: I use the moisturizer for this brand and I really liked it so I gave the cleanser a try. At first, it was great- product dispenses a good amount of cleanser, you apply it to the skin and it foams up removing make up and oils. When you rinse it off it doesn't feel dry or like the skin is stripped. I use this as a "pre cleanse" before using another cleanser that I use with my face brush. Lets fast forward to 2 months later I dropped it and the dispensing cap came off, this is when I noticed there was something brown on the inside of the cap. I looked deeper, and that same stuff is accumulated near where the spring inside the bottle is. I am not sure if this is mold or what it is, but I don't think this should be happening as this product is already expensive for an over the counter cleanser. The bottle has an expiration date of 4/2027 so it's surprising to me that I've only used it for 2 months and this happened. I don't feel safe using it, and it's not even half way gone so it's a complete waste of product. I don't know why this happened either since this cleanser was not in my shower, but in a cabinet and I take it out when I'm going to use it so it's not like there was exposure to water getting trapped in from the shower. This is weird, and it left a bad feeling about it. I wouldn't recommend it again until the company figures out a different way to dispense the product. I'll stay away from it for now, but overall it was a good cleanser I think just refigure the dispensing m
